response.original_title: Every hour, a word, a deed
response.overview: Every hour, a word, a deed – Jacques & Agneta Van Marken, pioneers in social entrepreneurship – a documentary about Jacques & Agneta Van Marken, pioneers in social entrepreneurship – This (short) documentary tells the remarkable story of the Van Marken couple, who laid the foundations in late 19th-century Delft for what we now call the welfare state. With initiatives such as employee housing, pension schemes, and social provisions, they were far ahead of their time. Their vision is more relevant than ever, now that broad-based prosperity and social entrepreneurship are once again high on the agenda.
response.title: Every hour, a word, a deed
